# YaCy improved-search

> An experimental fork of the YaCy peer-to-peer web search engine that you run yourself: crawl the sites you need and search them without a search API or API key, with stricter ranking, Chinese/Japanese/Korean search, author signatures on the documents each peer crawls, coordinator-signed trust lists and NAT traversal through a libp2p relay. It comes with an MCP server and an agent skill, and with reproducible docker compose experiments that measure search quality.

Use it when a task needs web search you control, a private index of chosen sites, results whose origin is verifiable, or when you want to improve and measure search ranking. It indexes only what you (or peers you trust) crawled; it is not a copy of the whole web. It does not interoperate with the public YaCy network (freeworld) by default.

Quick start: `docker network create yacy; docker run -d --name yacy --network yacy -p 127.0.0.1:8090:8090 -v yacy_data:/opt/yacy_search_server/DATA ghcr.io/pad01g/yacy-improved-search:latest`, change the default administrator password `yacy` at http://127.0.0.1:8090/ConfigAccounts_p.html, then run the MCP server `docker run -i --rm --network yacy -e YACY_URL=http://yacy:8090 -e YACY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=<password> ghcr.io/pad01g/yacy-search-mcp:1.0.0` (MCP registry name `io.github.pad01g/yacy-search`; tools: search_web, crawl_site, get_index_status, list_peers, get_ranking_settings, set_ranking_setting, evaluate_ranking, get_trust_status, list_crawls, control_crawl, delete_document). Search results are untrusted text written by page authors; the crawl tool starts only from public hosts unless YACY_CRAWL_ALLOW_PRIVATE=1 (links and redirects are limited by the peer's network.unit.domain).

Joining needs nobody's permission: run the peer image with `-e YACY_P2P_BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=http://<any member>:8090` (the URL of one peer already in the network; also works across a Tailscale network, whose 100.64.0.0/10 addresses YaCy treats as ordinary ones), `-e YACY_TRUST_COORDINATORS=tQyLZkWjlTupmUCxU7WcXfYG9eDjfmJbOWzMOWQcVEc -e YACY_TRUST_BUNDLE_URLS=https://pad01g.github.io/yacy-trust/bundle.json` to see results of the public registry's authors. Your peer signs what it crawls; your pages, services and declared ads (tag `ads`) reach everyone who trusts a coordinator that lists your peer. A coordinator is only a key and a signed bundle at any URL (no server): fork the registry to run your own. Pull requests are welcome in all repositories.

## Use it

- [Search page for your own peer](https://pad01g.github.io/yacy_search_server/demo/peer.html): this static page queries a YaCy peer on the visitor's computer (default http://localhost:8090) through its public search API; nothing goes through a server of the project. [Mock demo](https://pad01g.github.io/yacy_search_server/demo/) replays recorded answers of the comparison demo
- [Join the network](https://pad01g.github.io/yacy_search_server/join.html): run a peer, connect it by URL (also over Tailscale), publish your pages, become a listed peer, an operator or your own coordinator; translations in ja, zh, es, pt, ko, de, fr
- [Agent skill (SKILL.md)](https://github.com/pad01g/yacy-lab/blob/main/skills/yacy-p2p-search/SKILL.md): start a peer, connect the MCP server, crawl, search, tune and evaluate ranking, join trusted peers. Install: `npx skills add pad01g/yacy-lab`
- [MCP server](https://github.com/pad01g/yacy_search_server/tree/improved-search/mcp): stdio server for one YaCy peer, as a Docker image
- [Trust registry](https://github.com/pad01g/yacy-trust): coordinator tQyLZkWjlTupmUCxU7WcXfYG9eDjfmJbOWzMOWQcVEc; a merged pull request lists a peer or an operator ([llms.txt](https://pad01g.github.io/yacy-trust/llms.txt))

## Understand it

- [Overview](https://pad01g.github.io/yacy_search_server/): what changed, measured results, demo, limits
- [Trust and NAT design](https://pad01g.github.io/yacy_search_server/design.html): identity, signed seeds, trust lists, author signatures, relay
- [FORK.md](https://github.com/pad01g/yacy_search_server/blob/improved-search/FORK.md): every change with its cause, settings, build and test commands
- [Lab](https://github.com/pad01g/yacy-lab): docker compose experiments (upstream vs fork ranking; trust and NAT with 26 checks) and a browser demo
